_note: Hand-written (Claude, 2026-09-18). Short SINGLE-CLAUSE probe targets, 4 per claim, each with a minimal local negation. Introduced after A1 showed the TTPD probe reads only the last clause of long multi-clause statements at early layers and is confounded by true sub-details (e.g. '9.79 seconds'). label: affirm = 0 (false in reality), negated = 1. 'verifiable': whether the base model can in principle know the affirmative is false (dentist: invented entity, so no).
